verdicts.reason: A puts the legal line between the headline and the CTA, set far too large and almost touching the headline descenders, with an orphaned 'Co., 2026.' second line, so the fine print competes with the message and breaks the reading order. The logo (top right) and the sale banner (top left) are also split apart. B keeps the order headline → CTA and moves the legal text to the side of the CTA, but its alignment is mixed: the headline is centred, the CTA is left-aligned and the legal text is centred in a right column. The product also floats alone in the top right, away from the headline, and the big circle sitting behind the headline makes that area look muddy.
